learning_outcomes.text: The student can structure their bachelor's thesis in terms of time and content after completing the course.
The student masters procedures and tools for preparing scientific papers.
The task for the bachelor's thesis is designed accordingly, and fundamental information for processing the bachelor's thesis is developed and structured.
The student is able to break down complex tasks into work packages and convert them into a time schedule.

assessment_rules: Student knowledge is assessed based on a written house work or an oral examination, which is an ungraded examination (XS). The type of examination will be announced upon registration for the Bachelor Thesis.
bibliography: Hering, L., Hering, H.: Technische Berichte, Vieweg, 4. Aufl., 2003
